messages:
noah: Hi all, new hire here. First CI run failed. GH Actions passed but Buildkite immediately errors with auth. Any quick checklist?

lee: welcome! Paste the build log + are you on a company-provisioned VM or your laptop?

noah: Log: 
```
2026-03-22T08:11:07Z ERROR: register: 403 Forbidden - app installation missing repository access
```

pat: That usually means the Redwood CI GitHub App wasn't granted access to the repo. During onboarding folks sometimes install to their personal account by accident.

noah: I clicked the install link from the doc and accepted. Where do I verify?

lee: GitHub -> Organization settings -> Installed GitHub Apps -> Redwood CI -> Configure. Make sure the repo is listed (either "All repositories" or add the specific repo). Also need Checks & Deployments perms.

buildkite-bot: Buildkite build #22 failed: see https://buildkite.com/redwood/infra/22/jobs/3

noah: I don't have org admin. Pat, can you confirm the app has access?

pat: On it. Also check agent token: if the agent token is old we get registration 401/403 after app fix. Use Buildkite -> Teams -> Agents -> New token (scope: agent).

infra-bot: Request: @pat granted 'repo access' to 'infra/new-hire-sandbox' for Redwood CI.

noah: Repo added. I regenerated agent token and restarted the agent on the VM with `sudo systemctl restart buildkite-agent`. Retriggering build...

buildkite-bot: Buildkite build #23 started: https://buildkite.com/redwood/infra/23

noah: Build picked up but stuck on Docker pull: `failed to pull image gcr.io/redwood-ci/base:latest - 403`

lee: That indicates GCR service account keys missing on the VM. If you used a prebuilt image you might need the CI creds. Check /etc/ci-creds/gcr-key.json and run `gcloud auth activate-service-account --key-file /etc/ci-creds/gcr-key.json`.

noah: I reused an old dev VM and missed that. Pat, can infra attach the key?

pat: Done via SSM. Pulled key, ran auth, docker pull succeeded locally. Re-run.

buildkite-bot: Buildkite build #23 succeeded.

noah: Thanks! Two follow-ups: add a note in onboarding about "reused VMs" and who to ping for token rotations.

lee: Yep please open a tiny docs PR. For rotations ping #eng-infra and @infra-bot will escalate. Welcome! :wave:
